## ==========================================================
## Regression-based permutation analysis for EEG data
## Simple between-subject design: Control vs Treatment
##
## Data dimensions:
##   Subjects x Channels x Time
##
## Model:
##   EEG ~ group
##
## Group coding:
##   -1 = Control
##    1 = Treatment
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

set.seed(123)

## ==========================================================
## Load data
## ==========================================================

# Example:
# You need an R object called `data`
# dimensions: subjects x channels x time
#
# You also need:
# group: length nSub, coded -1 / 1
# times: time vector

# If your MATLAB file is saved as .mat, use R.matlab:
# install.packages("R.matlab")
library(R.matlab)

mat <- readMat("../data/01_simulated_between_subject_EEG.mat")

data  <- mat$data
group <- as.vector(mat$group)
times <- as.vector(mat$times)

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================

nSub  <- dim(data)[1]
nChan <- dim(data)[2]
nTime <- dim(data)[3]

if (length(group) != nSub) {
  stop("Length of group does not match number of subjects.")
}

if (length(times) != nTime) {
  stop("Length of times does not match number of time points.")
}

if (!all(group %in% c(-1, 1))) {
  stop("group must be coded as -1 = Control and 1 = Treatment.")
}

## ==========================================================
## Function: compute regression t-map
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap_lm <- function(data, predictor) {
  
  nSub  <- dim(data)[1]
  nChan <- dim(data)[2]
  nTime <- dim(data)[3]
  
  tMap <- matrix(NA, nrow = nChan, ncol = nTime)
  
  predictor <- as.vector(predictor)
  
  for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
    
    for (tp in seq_len(nTime)) {
      
      eeg_local <- as.numeric(data[, ch, tp])
      
      fit <- lm(eeg_local ~ predictor)
      
      tMap[ch, tp] <- summary(fit)$coefficients["predictor", "t value"]
    }
  }
  
  return(tMap)
}


tfce_2d <- function(stat_map,
                    chan_neighbors,
                    dh = 0.1,
                    e_power = 2/3,
                    h_power = 2) {
  
  n_chan <- nrow(stat_map)
  n_time <- ncol(stat_map)
  
  abs_map <- abs(stat_map)
  sign_map <- sign(stat_map)
  
  max_h <- max(abs_map, na.rm = TRUE)
  thresholds <- seq(0, max_h, by = dh)
  
  scores <- matrix(0, nrow = n_chan, ncol = n_time)
  
  for (ti in seq_along(thresholds)) {
    
    thresh <- thresholds[ti]
    
    if (ti == 1) {
      h <- abs(thresh)
    } else {
      h <- abs(thresh - thresholds[ti - 1])
    }
    
    h <- h^h_power
    
    supra <- abs_map >= thresh
    visited <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n_chan, ncol = n_time)
    
    for (ch in seq_len(n_chan)) {
      for (tp in seq_len(n_time)) {
        
        if (!supra[ch, tp] || visited[ch, tp]) {
          next
        }
        
        cluster <- matrix(c(ch, tp), ncol = 2)
        queue <- matrix(c(ch, tp), ncol = 2)
        visited[ch, tp] <- TRUE
        
        while (nrow(queue) > 0) {
          
          current <- queue[1, , drop = FALSE]
          queue <- queue[-1, , drop = FALSE]
          
          c_ch <- current[1, 1]
          c_tp <- current[1, 2]
          
          chan_neigh <- which(chan_neighbors[c_ch, ] == 1)
          time_neigh <- c(c_tp - 1, c_tp + 1)
          time_neigh <- time_neigh[time_neigh >= 1 & time_neigh <= n_time]
          
          neigh_nodes <- rbind(
            cbind(chan_neigh, c_tp),
            cbind(c_ch, time_neigh)
          )
          
          for (k in seq_len(nrow(neigh_nodes))) {
            
            nch <- neigh_nodes[k, 1]
            ntp <- neigh_nodes[k, 2]
            
            if (supra[nch, ntp] && !visited[nch, ntp]) {
              visited[nch, ntp] <- TRUE
              queue <- rbind(queue, c(nch, ntp))
              cluster <- rbind(cluster, c(nch, ntp))
            }
          }
        }
        
        extent <- nrow(cluster)
        
        for (k in seq_len(nrow(cluster))) {
          c_ch <- cluster[k, 1]
          c_tp <- cluster[k, 2]
          
          scores[c_ch, c_tp] <- scores[c_ch, c_tp] +
            h * (extent^e_power)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  tfce_map <- scores * sign_map
  
  return(tfce_map)
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed regression t-map
## ==========================================================
tObs <- compute_tmap_lm(data, group)
TFCEObs <- 
## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Permutation test using max-t correction
## ==========================================================

nPerm <- 1

permMaxT <- numeric(nPerm)

for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
  
  if (p %% 50 == 0) {
    message("Permutation ", p, " / ", nPerm)
  }
  
  permGroup <- sample(group)
  
  permT <- compute_tmap_lm(data, permGroup)
  
  permTFCE <- 
  
  permMaxTFCE[p] <- max(abs(permTFCE), na.rm = TRUE)
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Corrected p-values
## ==========================================================

pValues <- matrix(NA, nrow = nChan, ncol = nTime)

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (tp in seq_len(nTime)) {
    
    pValues[ch, tp] <- 
      (sum(permMaxTFCE >= abs(TFCEObs[ch, tp])) + 1) / 
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

alpha <- 0.05
mask <- pValues < alpha

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: Plot significant TFCE-values
## ==========================================================

sigT <- TFCEObs
sigT[!mask] <- 0

image(
  x = times,
  y = seq_len(nChan),
  z = t(sigT),
  xlab = "Time (ms)",
  ylab = "Channel",
  main = "Regression-based max-t corrected effects",
  col = hcl.colors(100, "RdBu", rev = TRUE)
)

axis(1)
axis(2)

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

Results <- list(
  tObs = tObs,
  permMaxT = permMaxT,
  pValues = pValues,
  mask = mask,
  alpha = alpha,
  nPerm = nPerm,
  model = "EEG ~ group"
)

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(
  Results,
  tObs,
  permMaxT,
  pValues,
  mask,
  times,
  group,
  file = "../results/01_between_subject_regression_permutation_R.RData"
)

message("Regression-based permutation analysis completed.")
